events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey patches, pipeline files, doc and Docker state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; ls tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2/; ls pipeline/; git log --oneline -1 origin/main 2>/dev/null; git status --short pipeline tantra-product-patches; grep -n -i "local preview\|empty\|no data yet\|dogfood\|tier" pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md | head -30; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo DOCKER_UP; ls ~/Documents/GitHub | grep -i tantra

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read pilot table, JSON and script
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; sed -n 40,56p pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md; python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('pipeline/local_pilot.json'));print(json.dumps(d)[:1500])"; cat pipeline/local_pilot.sh | head -80

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find scratch copy, check commit, dash test, board
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; grep -rn "scratch" pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md | head -5; ls -d /tmp/*t154* /tmp/*scratch* ~/Documents/GitHub/*scratch* 2>/dev/null; git show --stat HEAD | head -20; python3 pipeline/test_dash.py 2>&1 | tail -3; curl -s "http://localhost:8899/pipeline?v=verify1" | grep -o -i "local preview[^<]\{0,80\}" | head -3; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commit history and scratch location
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; for f in pipeline/local_pilot.sh pipeline/dash.py tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2/fix_red-suites--f0b901e.patch tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2/ci_premerge-and-preview--f0b901e.patch; do echo "$f: $(git log -1 --format='%h %s' -- $f | cut -c1-90)"; done; git status --short pipeline tantra-product-patches; git ls-files --others pipeline tantra-product-patches; grep -n "local_pilot" pipeline/dash.py | head; ls -d /tmp/* /private/tmp/* 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "backend|t154|pilot" | head

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check scratch copy matches f0b901e and has no remote
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t154-scratch && git remote -v | wc -l; git branch | head; git status --short | head -5; ls -d node_modules >/dev/null && echo NM; cd ~/Documents/GitHub/tantra-backend-v2 && git rev-parse --short f0b901e && git diff --stat f0b901e -- . 2>/dev/null | tail -1; diff -rq --exclude=.git --exclude=node_modules --exclude=dist --exclude=.pilot-logs <(cd ~/Documents/GitHub/tantra-backend-v2 && git ls-tree -r f0b901e | awk '{print $3}' | sort | md5) <(cd /tmp/t154-scratch && git ls-tree -r development | awk '{print $3}' | sort | md5) && echo SAME_TREE_AS_f0b901e
